title: zprof thresholds file
description: Live alarm levels, run pass criteria and the build-compare gate (docs/DASHBOARD_SPEC.md section 7). Every rule: breach when value <op> threshold; warn and crit are both optional, at least one is required.

metric.description: Catalog ID (spec section 3). '*' matches one instance segment, e.g. stack.*.margin.

level.description: Live status for KPI tiles, bullets and tables.

criterion.description: A run pass criterion. crit breach = FAIL, warn breach = WARN.

agg.description: How the metric is reduced over the run (and over DUTs, worst wins).

per.description: dut: evaluate per DUT and report the worst one.

judge.description: slope only. interval: FAIL when the whole confidence interval breaches crit, WARN when the point estimate does.

gateRule.description: Build-compare rule. Any crit breach blocks the build; any warn needs review.

mode.description: absolute: candidate value; delta: candidate minus baseline; delta_pct: that delta as % of baseline.
